versions.changelog:
Initial release of work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper.

- Helps users implement and adapt Gog-style workflows for Google Workspace productivity needs.
- Focuses on bug fixing, setup hardening, safety improvements, reliability, and adjacent skill creation.
- Provides clear workflow steps for request analysis, artifact creation, and validation.
- Ensures outputs are actionable, locally feasible, and easy to reuse or verify.
- Triggers on keywords related to Google Workspace productivity, CLI, and common workflow tasks.
